# Support

- Read the [README](../README.md), [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), and [ADRs](../docs/adr/README.md).
- Inspect any component or theme directly from the CLI:
  ```bash
  cargo run -p refractor-cli -- component --list
  cargo run -p refractor-cli -- theme list
  ```
- Open a GitHub Issue for bugs or feature requests.
